Side AB is labeled 15, side BC is labeled 20, and hypotenuse AC is labeled 25. Reasoning: The problem asks to express sin A as a decimal rounded to the hundredths place. In a right triangle, sin A = the opposite side of angle A / the hypotenuse. The opposite side of angle A is BC = 20, and the hypotenuse is AC = 25, so sin A = 20/25 = 0.8. Written to the hundredths place, it is 0.80.
